title: Foliar Symptomology, Nutrient Content, Yield, and Secondary Metabolite Variability of Cannabis Grown Hydroponically with Different Single-Element Nutrient Deficiencies
notes: Cannabis-specific hydroponic deficiency study for N, P, K, Ca, Mg, S, Fe and Mn. Supports symptom-pattern education and the need to integrate visual evidence with tissue analysis. Single-element omission under one controlled system does not reproduce every field/facility deficiency or mixed stress.
